items.summary_orig: Distributed systems are hard to test because partial failures overlap with live traffic and the same fault can produce different execution traces on different runs. items.summary_orig: wf-verify: One Verify Gate for Every Ecosystem Agentic loops break down at the verify step. The agent writes code, then either skips verification or runs a command that only covers one ecosystem. A Go repo gets go test ; a Bun repo gets bun test ; a mixed repo gets nothing consistent. The result: "it passed" means different things in different projects.

items.summary_orig: OpenCode Workflow Loop: spec → implement → verify → review → ship Vibe-coding gets you a demo. It rarely gets you a shippable repo. The gap is not the model; it is the missing structure around the model: a spec to aim at, a verify gate to catch regressions, a review pass to catch the things tests do not, and a ship step that does not skip the boring parts.

items.title: 爱彼迎推出 CASTLE，用于使用合成数据训练自然语言搜索模型
items.title_orig: Airbnb Introduces CASTLE for Training Natural Language Search Models with Synthetic Data
items.summary: 爱彼迎研究人员推出了 CASTLE，这是一个旨在解决自然语言搜索中冷启动问题的框架。该方法使用去标识化的预订会话和大语言模型（LLM）共同生成合成搜索查询和相关性标签，从而实现模型训练。
items.summary_orig: Airbnb researchers have introduced CASTLE, a framework designed to address the cold-start problem in natural language search. The approach uses de-identified booking sessions and large language models (LLMs) to jointly generate synthetic search queries and relevance labels, enabling model training before sufficient real search traffic is available.

items.title: 神经网络为何自信却出错，以及如何校准

items.summary_orig: A classifier that says it is 90% sure should be right about 90% of the time. That sounds like a low bar, and yet most modern neural networks fail it badly. They are routinely 99% confident and wrong, or 60% confident and right almost every time. Their accuracy can be excellent while their confidence is meaningless.

items.summary_orig: When low-mass stars like our Sun age, they leave the main sequence and follow the Red Giant Branch. As they ascend this branch, their luminosity steadily increases. But there's a sort of hiccup in the path called the RGB luminosity bump, where their luminosity suddenly dips.

items.summary: 根据新的研究，火星的火山活动可能比我们想象的更加活跃。微量气体轨道飞行器在一年中的某个时候检测到了 HCl（一种与岩浆有关的化学物质），除了火山喷发之外，这种情况很难进行。这项新研究还发现了火星上新的表面裂缝，这可能是其来源
items.summary_orig: Mars may be more volcanically active than we thought, according to new research. The Trace Gas Orbiter detected HCl, a chemical associated with magma, at a time of year that's difficult except by volcanic origins. The new research also identified new surface fissures on Mars that could be the source of the chemical.

items.title: 一种常见的食品乳化剂可以解决火箭技术最古老的燃料问题之一
items.title_orig: A Common Food Emulsifier Could Solve One of Rocketry’s Oldest Fuel Problems
items.summary: 在推进系统设计中，工程师长期以来一直面临着固体和液体火箭燃料之间的权衡。每种燃料都有优点和缺点，为了尝试最小化/最大程度地提高不同类型燃料的功效，研究人员长期以来一直将重点放在固体和液体之间的混合上
items.summary_orig: In propulsion system design, engineers have long faced a trade-off between solid and liquid rocket fuels. Each has advantages and disadvantages, and in an effort to try to min/max the efficacy of different types of fuel, researchers have long placed an emphasis on a hybrid between solids and liquids - in other words they’ve been working with gels.
